title: [5/9/2024] A school library 5 years ago and the same library now
prompt: The plans show a school library 5 years ago and the same library now. Summarize the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

frame.name: Introduction
paragraphs: The plans compare the layout of a school library as it was five years ago with its current arrangement.

frame.name: Overview
paragraphs: Overall, the library has undergone significant modifications over the five-year period, with the most notable change being the modernization of study spaces. Another substantial change can be seen in the reorganization of functional areas, with several spaces being divided or repurposed for more specialized uses.

frame.name: Body 1
paragraphs: On the western side of the library five years ago, there were three main areas: a classroom at the top, a meeting room in the middle, and a borrowing and returning desk at the bottom. In the current layout, the classroom has been converted into a recording studio, while the meeting room remains in its original position. However, the borrowing and returning functions have been separated into two distinct areas.

frame.name: Body 2
paragraphs: Regarding the eastern and central section, the library office that was present five years ago has been replaced by a conference room. There were desks for computers 5 years ago, but they have been repurposed to store students' laptops. Additionally, in the central area, the original studying tables have been transformed into private studying tables, and a new desk specifically for students' laptops has been installed below them.
